mentions.h: 50 GLORIOUS YEARS ON THE BRIGHTON ROAD
mentions.note: 3rd Brighton walk 1920; called the father of distance walking in the club
memorial trophy for a long-distance walking event (spelt Belchamber on page 4)
Jimmy Bellchamber Cup, won by Eric Hall
3rd in Brighton race (one of 1920-24); the Club's first great long distance walker; 2nd in Brighton and Back 1921 in 20hrs. 53mins. 35secs., first Belgrave Centurion; team scorer 1924

share.d: Jimmy Bellchamber in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1950–1975: 7 mentions in 7 issues and 2 race results.
